decisions.reason: The source changes only the hero visual asset; it does not alter the hero headline or supporting copy.
Message 88 concerns the hero image. The bottom-of-page image is a separate asset and is discussed separately in message 89.
Replacing one hero visual does not change the landing page content mix, specification source, or screenshot-selection rule.
The selected hero asset changes, but the clean minimal SaaS style, brand palette source, and approved overall design remain unchanged.
The mobile phone mentioned in the source is part of the hero graphic and does not affect contact-channel options.
The source does not change any information collected by the early-access form.
The reference to a sales page describes the hero graphic and does not modify the founding-dealer contact-page copy.
The hero visual replacement has no effect on form-submission delivery triggers or recipients.
The source changes a hero image asset and does not alter the early-access button or its destination.
Replacing the hero image does not introduce or otherwise change animation behavior.
The source does not change the dealer-login button or its top-right-only placement.
